metadata.title: Product Bricks & Streams
metadata.description: Brick map of zvoove Group's temporary-staffing software portfolio: recruiting and CRM (zvoove Recruit, Cockpit, Cockpit X, RecruitNow, Online Results), staffing ERP and dispatch (zvoove One, Kentro, WorkExpert, Nivel IV), workforce management (Planbition, Plan4Flex, HelloFlex), payroll and billing (zvoove Payroll, mywage), VMS (DirectSkills), managed services (profitask) and AI agents (Pixi, zAIn).

rootGroups.name: Talent Acquisition and Client Sales
rootGroups.description: Winning candidates and clients: ads, applicant tracking, AI recruiting agents, matching and CRM.

bricks.name: Job Ads, Multiposting and Recruitment Marketing
bricks.description: Turns a client order or talent-pool need into job ads, publishes them to job boards, social channels and the agency career site, and measures cost per applicant per channel. Mirrors zvoove Recruit multiposting, zvoove Campaigns and the Online Results recruitment-marketing agency in the Netherlands.

layers.description: Recruiter-facing ad authoring and the public career site.

modules.name: Job Ad Editor
modules.description: Template-based ad editor with AI text suggestions, salary transparency fields and preview per board.
Saves and publishes ads.

modules.name: Agency Career Site
modules.description: Branded, SEO-indexed job list and one-click apply form per agency tenant.
Reads published ads.

layers.description: APIs for ads and apply events.

modules.name: Job Ad API
modules.description: CRUD and publication state for ads, linked to client orders or talent-pool campaigns.

modules.name: Multiposting Worker
modules.description: Posts, refreshes and withdraws ads on connected job boards and Google for Jobs.

modules.name: Campaign and Channel Budget Service
modules.description: Holds campaign budgets, targeting and cost-per-applicant per channel.

modules.name: Job Board and Social Connectors

brickDependencies.description: Ads are generated from open client orders and their requirements.

dataDependencies.description: System of record for published vacancies and their channel performance.

externalSystemsDependingOnThisBrick.description: Apply clicks land on the career site.

bricks.name: Applicant Tracking and Candidate Pipeline
bricks.description: Captures every application from every channel, deduplicates candidates, runs the screening pipeline and keeps the talent pool GDPR-clean. The core of zvoove Recruit and zvoove Cockpit, RecruitNow Cockpit in the Netherlands, and the ATS layer of the regional ERPs.

Modeled on zvoove Cockpit X (published claim: 250 hours saved per month by the application agent at one customer).

rootGroups.name: Placement and Workforce Operations
rootGroups.description: Placing, contracting, scheduling and supporting workers at client sites.

bricks.name: Client Orders, Assignments and Dispatch
bricks.description: The Disposition heart of a staffing ERP: client orders with positions and requirements, assignment of workers, rates and surcharges per assignment, and the dispatcher board that shows who works where this week. Core of zvoove One, Kentro (Pivoton), WorkExpert (ProSolution) and Nivel IV.

modules.name: Dispatch Board
modules.description: Week view of orders, open positions, assigned workers and conflicts.
Reads orders.
Creates assignments.

modules.description: Orders, positions, requirements, bill rates and client sites.

bricks.name: Staffing Contracts and e-Signature
bricks.description: Generates the legally required document set per assignment - the employment contract with the worker and the leasing contract (Arbeitnehmerüberlassungsvertrag / uitzendovereenkomst) with the client - and collects qualified e-signatures before work starts. DirectSkills publishes 1.735 million contracts produced and signed in 2024 in France.

modules.name: Contract Tracker

Reads contract status.

modules.description: Creates, versions and cancels contract documents per assignment.

modules.name: Contract Generator
modules.description: Country and collective-agreement specific templates filled from assignment data.

modules.name: e-Signature Connector
modules.description: Qualified and advanced electronic signature providers.

dataDependencies.description: System of record for employment and leasing contracts.

bricks.name: Staffing Compliance Rules Engine
bricks.description: Machine-readable labour-leasing rules per country: German AÜG with equal pay after nine months, maximum leasing duration of 18 months and GVP collective agreements with sector surcharges; Dutch ABU/NBBU CAO phases and the Wtta admission regime (in force 1 January 2027); Swiss, Austrian, Spanish and French equivalents. zvoove One states that law and tariff changes are applied automatically.

modules.name: Compliance Cockpit
modules.description: Upcoming equal-pay dates, leasing-duration limits and missing documents per worker and client.
Evaluates status.

modules.name: Rules Evaluation API
modules.description: Evaluates an assignment, pay line or contract against the active rule set and returns violations and required values.

modules.name: Deadline Monitor
modules.description: Daily scan for equal-pay start, maximum duration, permit expiry and CAO phase changes.

modules.name: Collective Agreement and Rule Set Service
modules.description: Versioned tariffs, surcharges, phases and legal limits by country and effective date.

brickDependencies.description: Country packs select which rule sets apply to a tenant.

dataDependencies.description: System of record for tariffs and legal limits.
Durations and start dates per assignment.

externalSystemsThisBrickDependsOn.system: Collective agreement publications (GVP / BAP-DGB, iGZ, ABU, NBBU)
externalSystemsThisBrickDependsOn.description: Source of tariff and surcharge values.

bricks.name: Shift Planning and Scheduling
bricks.description: Plans shifts for pools of flex workers at client sites - demand, rosters, availability, qualifications and labour-law checks - with AI-assisted plan generation. Modeled on Planbition (1,000+ installations, 17+ countries, Planbition X plain-language scheduling), Plan4Flex mid-office and mywage myschedule.

bricks.description: Lets a newly placed worker complete personnel data, tax and social-security details, bank account, ID and work-permit upload themselves, and answers routine questions about contracts, hours and payslips through an AI agent on WhatsApp. Modeled on Pixi (acquired August 2026, launching in Switzerland first) and mywage myhr.

rootGroups.description: Paying workers and billing clients from the same hours, plus filings and managed services.

bricks.name: Staffing Payroll Engine
bricks.description: Gross-to-net payroll built for temporary work: collective-agreement pay groups, sector surcharges, equal-pay switch-over, working-time accounts, multiple assignments per period and retroactive corrections. zvoove Payroll, adata-heritage payroll know-how, HelloFlex back office and mywage payroll (published claim: up to 60% less payroll processing time).

bricks.name: Pay-on-Demand Advances
bricks.description: Lets workers draw part of already-earned wages before payday, capped by approved hours, and settles advances in the next payroll run. Modeled on mywage mypod (UK); availability varies by country.

bricks.description: Social-security and tax reporting, authority notifications and accounting exports that payroll and billing trigger: DEÜV and eAU in Germany, loonaangifte in the Netherlands, RTI in the UK, SILTRA/Contrat@ in Spain, DATEV and other accounting exports. zvoove One advertises that notification processes are built in.

modules.name: Accounting Export
